g.text: Git stores artifact history, not a second memory service
No working tree, remote or Git
After a restart, cleanup finishes before reads reopen.
Exports and backups are handled separately.
Export selected artifacts, not private history, to a team repository for review
Sanitized manifest, exact lineage, appropriate recipient access
Deleting a file or ref doesn't forget anything. Local cleanup can't erase SSD remnants, backups, snapshots or exported copies.
